events.title: Large-support exact ROBDD certificate lane survives semantic-oracle gate
statement: Under a fixed root order, exact B2 NOT/AND ROBDD construction and verification are polynomial in explicit diagram bytes.
Restriction and residual nonconstancy plus explicit 0/1 witnesses are polynomial in explicit diagram bytes.
Parity proves that polynomially large root support can coexist with a linear exact certificate.
Therefore large support alone is not the hidden exponential.

events.title: Residual-function frontier and variable-order discovery become the next exact exponent
statement: For a frozen variable order, distinct residual functions after a prefix cannot merge into one reduced ordered state; the maximum residual frontier lower-bounds ROBDD size.
EQ_n has an O(n) B2 DAG but 2^n residual functions after the X cut under X-then-Y order, while an interleaved order gives linear ROBDD size.
Bollig and Wegener (1996) prove the general OBDD variable-order improvement problem NP-complete; generic good-order search therefore cannot be treated as a free selector operation.
This external result does not prove order-discovery hardness for the exact NW target macro class.
boundaries: No order-independent OBDD lower bound for target NW macros is proved.
No target-NW ordering NP-hardness theorem is proved.
Exact survival is still not global proof progress.
